review_method: Source-content inspection of every attached non-primary/support source, with targeted embedded-binding inspection. Third-party library dependency identity is distinguished from authored helper implementations.
scope_limitations: This is a source-accounting audit, not a revalidation of compiler/runtime implementations or stopwatch results.
Embedded sections are evidence ranges, not newly qualified normalized LOC splits.
Single-file sources were screened for native-binding indicators; absence of a match is not a semantic proof that every helper is workload-specific.
Generated compiler outputs and installed dependencies outside source bundles are not counted or recertified.
